candidates.readme_excerpt:
# Tarjuman **Live translated captions for any meeting, any app, on your own PC.** Tarjuman (ترجمان, "interpreter") listens to the audio your computer is playing, transcribes it locally with Whisper, translates it in near real time, and shows the result in a small always-on-top overlay. It is not tied to Zoom, Meet or Teams: if you can hear it, Tarjuman can caption it. [![License: GPL v3](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-GPL--3.0-blue.svg)](LICENSE) ![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/python-3.12-3776AB.svg) ![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-Windows%2010%2F11-0078D4.svg) ![Tests](https://img.shields.io/badge/tests-241%20passing-brightgreen.svg)
> **Status: early but working (v0.1).** Today Tarjuman translates **English → Arabic** on **Windows**. The goal is any language to any language, for everyone. See the [Roadmap](ROADMAP.md) for what is done and what is missing. ## Language plan 1. **Now:** English → Arabic (implemented). 2. **Next:** Arabic → English, so conversations work in both directions (planned, not implemented yet). 3. **Then:** more languages, one at a time, using the same pipeline (planned). Right now the focus is **speed and quality** of the translation, not the number of languages. New languages come after the core is fast and accurate. ## Why Tarjuman Most live-translation features are built into one product (Zoom, Google Meet, Teams) and work only inside it. Tarjuman sits outside the meeting app, so it works with **any** source: a conference platform, a webinar, a YouTube lecture, a livestream, a recorded call. The mission: help people around the world talk to each other without a language barrier. ## How it works ``` system audio ─► VAD ─► Whisper (local, GPU) ─► translation (Groq → DeepL) ─► overlay ``` | Stage | What it does | Code | |---|---|---| | Capture | Records all system audio, or a single application (per-app loopback) | `src/audio/` | | VAD | Silero VAD cuts silence so Whisper only sees speech | `src/audio/vad.py` | | Speech to text | `faster-whisper` on your GPU, with a hypothesis buffer that only commits words the model agrees on twice (less flicker) | `src/stt/` | | Translation | A quota-aware router tries Groq, then DeepL, with circuit breakers and backoff | `src/translation/` | | Overlay | Frameless, click-through, always-on-top window with proper right-to-left Arabic and a bundled Arabic font | `src/ui/` | ## Features - **Works with any audio source**, n

# vtts

[🇻🇳](https://huggingface.co/tuanpm/vtts/tree/main/vi-en-nu-10 "Vietnamese") [🇬🇧](https://huggingface.co/tuanpm/vtts/tree/main/en-nu-en "English") [🇨🇳](https://huggingface.co/tuanpm/vtts/tree/main/zh-en-nu-zh "Chinese") [🇰🇷](https://huggingface.co/tuanpm/vtts/tree/main/ko-en-nu-ko "Korean") [🇯🇵](https://huggingface.co/tuanpm/vtts/tree/main/ja-en-nu-ja "Japanese") [🇪🇸](https://huggingface.co/tuanpm/vtts/tree/main/es-en-nu-es "Spanish") [🇧🇷](https://huggingface.co/tuanpm/vtts/tree/main/pt-en-nu-pt "Portuguese (Brazil)") [🇮🇩](https://huggingface.co/tuanpm/vtts/tree/main/id-en-nu-id "Indonesian") [🇮🇳](https://huggingface.co/tuanpm/vtts/tree/main/hi-en-nu-hi "Hindi") [🇹🇭](https://huggingface.co/tuanpm/vtts/tree/main/th-en-nu-th "Thai")

# ReLoq C

ReLoq C is a speech synthesis project that preserves the familiar character of Eloquence while improving pronunciation, responsiveness and control over the voice. Apple Eloquence serves as the reference for language behaviour and sound.

The shared synthesis engine is written in C. NVDA, Android and Windows SAPI5 use the same core. The project is developed and tested with screen-reader users; language reliability, responsiveness and lower resource use remain active priorities.

**2.0.0** adds Aragonese, improves number handling and supplies additional NVDA interface translations.
**1.4.1** improves CamelCase and acronym handling and makes automatic NVDA dictionary updates non-modal.
**1.4.0** improves optional word segmentation and NVDA dictionary import,
fixes Italian words ending in an apostrophe, and adds Android x86-64 packages.
**1.2.2** adds an optional exact base pitch in hertz and improves German final
A before pauses. **1.2.1** refined the optional mellow voice mode for a softer,
less breathy sound. **1.2.0** improved Greek pronunciation and sentence melody,
dictionary startup, speech volume and SAPI responsiveness, and added a choice of
question intonation for German and American English.

## Download and install

The [latest release](https://github.com/hozosch/Reloq-C/releases/latest) provides installable packages for three platforms:

| Platform | Package | Requirements |
| --- | --- | --- |
| NVDA | `.nvda-addon` | NVDA 2026.1 or later, 64-bit process |
| Android | ARM64 or x86-64 `.apk` | Android 8 or later, matching device architecture |
| Windows SAPI5 | `-setup.exe` | Installs x64 and x86 voices together on compatible Windows |

Release **2.0.0** updates existing installations on all three platforms. If you are upgrading directly from the published 1.1 NVDA or Android package, consult the [1.1.1 transition notes](docs/releases/1.1.1.md) for the one-time identity change. See the [2.0.0 release notes](docs/releases/2.0.0.md) for this update. Source archives are for developers and are not installable packages.

## Current features

- **15 language variants**, including German, American and British English, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Greek and Aragonese.
- **Eight voice presets:** Reed, Shelly, Bobby, Rocko, Glen, Sandy, Grandma and Grandpa, with adjustable head size, pitch, roughness and breathiness.
- **Optional exact base pitch in hertz**, alongside the normal pitch controls.
- **Seven sample rates from 8 to 48 kHz**, covering th

# SPR: the Sealed Payment Record
[![luca-network/spr MCP server](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/luca-network/spr/badges/score.svg)](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/luca-network/spr)

Your AI agent pays for data, compute and services, and your finance team and auditor can't see what each payment was for. SPR records every payment your agent makes, before and after it pays, sealed with your company's own key on your own machine. Anyone can check the seals. No service has to be trusted, Luca's included.

```
npx -y @luca-network/spr-mcp
```

Free and open: Apache-2.0, with a royalty-free patent commitment ([`PATENTS.md`](PATENTS.md)).

## Use it from your AI tool

Every setup below runs the same MCP server on your machine. Set `SPR_AGENT_ID` (your agent) and `SPR_ENTITY` (the company it pays for); records go to `SPR_DIR`.

**Claude Desktop**: add to `claude_desktop_config.json`:

```json
{ "mcpServers": { "spr": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "@luca-network/spr-mcp"],
  "env": { "SPR_AGENT_ID": "agt_research", "SPR_ENTITY": "Example Co", "SPR_DIR": "/Users/you/spr-books" } } } }
```

**Cursor**: the same block in `.cursor/mcp.json`.

**Claude Code**:

```
claude mcp add spr -e SPR_AGENT_ID=agt_research -e SPR_ENTITY="Example Co" -- npx -y @luca-network/spr-mcp
```

**OpenAI Agents SDK** and **LangChain** (JavaScript):

```js
import { SprBook, toOpenAIAgentsTools, toLangChainTools } from "@luca-network/spr-sdk";
const book = new SprBook({ dir: "./books", agentId: "agt_research", entity: "Example Co" });
const tools = toOpenAIAgentsTools(book, tool);   // tool from "@openai/agents"; or toLangChainTools(book, tool)
```

**CrewAI, Microsoft Agent Framework, Google ADK and the Claude Agent SDK** (Python): each connects to the MCP server in a few lines. See [`examples/`](examples).

**Any other MCP client**: run `npx -y @luca-network/spr-mcp` over stdio with the two settings above.

The agent then calls `record_intent` before it pays, `check_payment` to see whether the payment is inside what it declared, goes to the payee it named and wasn't paid already, and `record_settlement` after it pays. Each record is sealed in the book's folder.

A merchant's book works the same way for payments received: it can keep the buyer's own sealed intent, how the buyer authenticated, and the order and processor references, and export one payment's evidence for a chargeback response (`export_dispute_pack`).

# agent-sim **iOS simulators for AI agents, on ordinary Linux machines.** No Mac, no GPU.

Safari on Apple's iOS runtime, on a Linux VM, recorded at 60 fps (the GIF is 15). Full clip · An agent driving Settings and Safari

> **agent-sim is built on [x86Sim](https://github.com/x86sim/x86sim) by [designgears](https://github.com/designgears).** > x86Sim is what runs Apple's iOS simulator on Linux, and it has done that since its first release. agent-sim is the > agent layer on top of it. If agent-sim is useful to you, [star x86Sim](https://github.com/x86sim/x86sim) too. agent-sim takes the iOS simulator that x86Sim runs on an x86-64 Linux VM and gives agents what they need to test iOS apps: install an `.ipa`, read the screen as text, tap, type, scroll, and watch it live in a browser. One command line for scripts and CI, and an MCP server for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and other agents. ``` $ agent-sim launch com.apple.Preferences && agent-sim snapshot app com.apple.Preferences @e1 button "Apple Account, Sign in to access your iCloud data, the App Store, Apple services, and more." (201,213) @e2 button "General" id="com.apple.settings.general" (201,320) @e3 button "Accessibility" id="com.apple.settings.accessibility" (201,372) ... $ agent-sim tap @e2 tapped @e2 button "General" ``` > **Status: early.** It works end to end; expect rough edges, and see [what does not work yet](docs/KNOWN_ISSUES.md). ## Quick start On an x86-64 Linux machine with Ubuntu 24.04 (8+ CPUs, 16 GB of memory, 60 GB of free disk): ```sh curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Developing-Gamer/agent-sim/main/install.sh | bash agent-sim setup # once, about half an hour: x86Sim, Apple's iOS runtime (8 GB, from Apple), a first phone agent-sim up # boot it: 12-30 s, depending on the CPU agent-sim snapshot ``` From a checkout instead: `cargo build --release`, then `scripts/setup-vm.sh` and `target/release/agent-sim`. `agent-sim setup --fidelity high --device hifi` adds a phone that looks exactly like Apple's simulator (3x, every blur and animation) for screenshots;

# Deuz SDK **One TypeScript SDK. Models, agents, and swarms.** Deuz is a TypeScript library that calls models from Anthropic, OpenAI, Google and other providers, and runs agents and swarms in your own process. It is for applications that must limit what a run spends and account for what it did: budgets shared across processes, receipts for tool calls, signed approvals, and runs that resume after a crash. [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/%40deuz-sdk%2Fcore?style=flat-square&label=npm&color=18181b)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@deuz-sdk/core) [![core runtime dependencies](https://img.shields.io/badge/core_runtime_dependencies-0-18181b?style=flat-square)](./packages/core/package.json) [![MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-18181b?style=flat-square)](./LICENSE) [Documentation](https://deuz-sdk.tech/docs) · [Examples](./examples) · [What's new in 2.5](./docs/content/docs/reference/whats-new-2-5.mdx) · [Changelog](./packages/core/CHANGELOG.md)
## Start building ```sh npm install @deuz-sdk/core ``` Set `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, then run your first agent: ```ts import { runAgent } from '@deuz-sdk/core/agent'; import { createAnthropic } from '@deuz-sdk/core/anthropic'; const anthropic = createAnthropic({ apiKey: process.env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY! }); const result = await runAgent({ model: anthropic('claude-opus-5-5'), prompt: 'Explain how rainbows form in three sentences.', maxSteps: 4, }); if (result.status === 'completed') console.log(result.output); else console.error(result.status, result.status === 'failed' ? result.error.message : ''); ``` Save it as `agent.mts` and run `node agent.mts`. Node.js runs a `.mts` file directly from 22.18 (on the 23 line, from 23.6); core itself supports Node.js 22 and newer. `createAnthropic` does not read the environment, so you pass the key in. Without a key the run returns `failed`, and the last line prints why. The [examples](./examples) run from a clone of this repository. 01–06 call Anthropic with your key. The rest need no key and no network, with two exceptions: `13-headless` calls Anthropic when `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` is set, and `23-docker-runner` needs a local Docker engine. ## Packages | Package | What it is | Status | | --- | -

candidates.description: Cross-agent skill: query and subscribe Google AI hidden offers via Play Billing on rooted Android emulator
candidates.readme_excerpt:
# Google AI Offer Subscription Skill

一个跨 Agent 通用的技能包：在已 root 的安卓模拟器上，通过 Google Play 结算库（BillingClient）查询 Google AI 的隐藏优惠 offer，拉起收银台并在确认 ¥0 后订阅；支持订阅升级叠加，把免费期延长到最长 24 个月。

> 这是非官方工具。优惠是否可领由服务方按账号投放，不保证成功。仅用于你自己的账号、设备和付款方式；使用前请自行评估是否符合相关服务条款。

## 背景

Google One 的部分促销 offer（如 AI Pro 的 12 个月免费、AI Ultra 的限时折扣）不会显示在普通页面上，只存在于 Play 结算库对特定账号的返回值里。本 skill 通过 Frida 注入 Google One 进程调用 BillingClient 查询这些 offer，挑出免费期最长的档位拉起收银台，并在确认金额为 0 时才点击订阅。

在 Android 15 模拟器上，上游脚本使用的 `Java.choose` 因 libart 符号缺失无法拿到前台 Activity，导致「查得到 offer、拉不起收银台」。本包附带实测修复版 `ultra0_patched.py`（改用 `ActivityThread.mActivities` 获取 Activity），并提供重新打补丁的脚本。

## 功能

- 环境探测：adb 连接、root、屏幕密度、frida-server、Google 组件状态（只读）
- offer 查询：`--list` 模式零风险，不消耗试用资格
- 订阅与叠加：12 个月免费 → +6 个月 → +6 个月（升级模式自动读 purchaseToken）
- 验收：读 Play 订阅页的下次付款日期，确认每次叠加生效
- 故障排查：常见坑的对照表

## 目录结构

```
google-ai-offer-subscription/
├── SKILL.md                  # 技能主入口（Agent 按需加载）
├── scripts/
│   ├── ultra0.py             # 上游公开脚本原始版
│   ├── ultra0_patched.py     # Android 15 兼容修复版（优先用）
│   ├── patch_ultra.py        # 从原始版重新生成修复版
│   ├── device_probe.py       # 只读环境探测
│   ├── read_screen.py        # uiautomator 读屏
│   └── verify_subscription.py# 订阅状态验收 + 截图
├── references/
│   ├── setup.md              # 一次性环境准备
│   ├── workflow.md           # 完整命令流程
│   └── troubleshooting.md    # 故障排查
└── LICENSE
```

## 安装（跨 Agent）

技能遵循通用 Agent Skills 规范（`SKILL.md` + frontmatter）。把整个 `google-ai-offer-subscription/` 目录复制到你所用 Agent 的 skills 目录：

| Agent | 全局目录 | 项目目录 |
|---|---|---|
| OpenCode | `~/.config/opencode/skills/` | `.opencode/skills/` |
| Claude Code | `~/.claude/skills/` | `.claude/skills/` |
| Codex CLI | `~/.codex/skills/` | `.agents/skills/` |

Windows PowerShell 一键装到 OpenCode 全局目录（其他 Agent 改路径即可）：

```powershell
$src = (Resolve-Path .\google-ai-offer-subscription).Path
$dst = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE ".config\opencode\skills\google-ai-offer-subscription"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path (Split-Path $dst) | Out-Null
Copy-Item -Recurse -Force $src $dst
```

安装后重启 Agent（或在会话里 `@google-ai-offer-subscription` 显式加载）。

## 快速开始

1. 先读 `SKILL.md` 和 `references/setup.md`，满足前置条件
2. `python scripts/device_probe.py` 确认环境
3. `python scripts/ultra0_patched.py --account <你的邮箱> --no-add --no-switch --check` 自检
4. 按 `references/workflow.md` 查询 → 下单 → 验收

**重要**：脚本不会索要密码或卡号；账号请自行在模拟器内登录，卡请自行在 Play 内绑定。下单前务必人工核对收银台的套餐名和金额；非 ¥0 不要点订阅。

## 上游与许可

- `scripts/ultra0.py` 来自公开项目 `github.com/gylive/google-ultra`，按其原许可使用；本仓库的补丁、文档与辅助脚本为 MIT（见 LICENSE）。
- 本仓

candidates.readme_excerpt: # Opengist Opengist is a **self-hosted** Pastebin **powered by Git**. All snippets are stored in a Git repository and can be read and/or modified using standard Git commands, or with the web interface. It is similar to [GitHub Gist](https://gist.github.com/), but open-source and could be self-hosted. [Home Page](https://opengist.io) • [Documentation](https://opengist.io/docs) • [Discord](https://discord.gg/9Pm3X5scZT) • [Demo](https://demo.opengist.io) ![GitHub release (latest SemVer)](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/thomiceli/opengist?sort=semver) ![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/thomiceli/opengist?color=blue) [![Go CI](https://github.com/thomiceli/opengist/actions/workflows/go.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/thomiceli/opengist/actions/workflows/go.yml) [![Go Report Card](https://goreportcard.com/badge/github.com/thomiceli/opengist)](https://goreportcard.com/report/github.com/thomiceli/opengist) [![Translate](https://tr.opengist.io/widget/_/svg-badge.svg)](https://tr.opengist.io/projects/_/opengist/) ## Features * Create public, unlisted or private snippets * [Init](/docs/usage/init-via-git.md) / Clone / Pull / Push snippets **via Git** over HTTP or SSH * Syntax highlighting ; markdown & CSV support * Search code in snippets; browse users snippets, likes and forks * Add topics to snippets * Embed snippets in other websites * Revisions history * Like / Fork snippets * Download raw files or as a ZIP archive * OAuth2 login with GitHub, GitLab, Gitea, and OpenID Connect * Restrict or unrestrict snippets visibility to anonymous users * Docker support / Helm Chart * [More...](/docs/introduction.md#features) ## Quick start ### With Docker Docker [images](https://github.com/thomiceli/opengist/pkgs/container/opengist) are available for each release : ```shell docker pull ghcr.io/thomiceli/opengist:1.16.0 ``` It can be used in a `docker-compose.yml` file : 1. Create a `docker-compose.yml` file with the following content 2. Run `docker compose up -d` 3. Opengist is now running on port 6157, you can browse http://localhost:6157 ```yml services: opengist: image: ghcr.io/thomiceli/opengist:1.16.0 container_name: opengist restart: unless-stopped ports: - "6157:6157" # HTTP port - "2222:2222" # SSH port, can be removed if you don't use SSH volumes: - "

candidates.description: Claude Code・Codex・Antigravity などの AI コーディングエージェントに、執筆意図と文機能つきで一文ずつ日本語の文章を執筆・レビューさせるスキルと閲覧アプリ
candidates.readme_excerpt: # tsuzuri English: [README.en.md](README.en.md) tsuzuri は Claude Code・Codex・Antigravity などの AI コーディングエージェントに日本語の文章を執筆させる際に、AI が生成した文章の品質を向上させるためのスキルと閲覧アプリです。 ユーザーは閲覧アプリで文ごとに AI の執筆意図（その文で読み手に何をするか）と文機能（文の役割や前の文との接続）を確認し、違和感を覚えた文にコメントを残して、AI に修正を依頼できます。 この README も tsuzuri で執筆しました。 この README では執筆意図を先に記述させる理由、使用方法、執筆の手順と文機能の語彙の根拠を、その順に説明していきます。 ## 執筆意図を先に記述させる理由 私は、「まとめて文章を生成させると、どうにも AI の思考が自分の手から離れた感覚がして扱いづらい」と感じていました。 tsuzuri のアイデアの根幹は、その感覚を元にした「AI が何を考えてその文を書いたのかを可視化できれば、レビューが容易になるのではないか」というお風呂中の思いつきです。 tsuzuri は一文を執筆する前に、その文で読み手に何をするかを執筆意図として AI に先に記述させます。 執筆したあとには、その文の役割・前の文との接続・重要度を、文機能として AI に付与させます。 ユーザーは一文ごとの役割と、AI が何を考えてその文を執筆したかを読んで理解できます。 意図がずれている箇所や、言い回しが気に入らない箇所を発見した場合は、コメントすることで AI に修正を依頼できます。 執筆意図と文機能がその一文の果たすべき要件と持つべき性質を示しているため、ユーザーもその要件に見合う文を自分で提案しやすくなります。 ## 要件定義から推敲までの執筆の流れ 「tsuzuri で書いて」と依頼すると、AI は次の順で文章を執筆します。 1. 要件定義書で、何を誰のためになぜ執筆するか、何を扱い何を扱わないか、読み終えた読み手が何をできるようになるかを決定します。 2. 設計書で、段落ごとの主張と順序を決定します。 3. 一文ずつ、執筆意図、文、文機能の順に執筆します。 4. 執筆を終えた文章を、各文が執筆意図を果たしているかでレビューし、改善の案を AI 自身が反映します。 5. 校正辞書（標準の辞書と、ユーザーが追加した辞書）に沿って表記を統一し、yomiyasu（日本語の言い回しを推敲する別のスキル）で言い回しを推敲します。 6. 設計書や執筆意図を与えない別の AI に読ませ、何を指すか理解できずにつまずいた箇所を修正します。 手順4で、材料に無い事実が必要な案と、意味・数値・確かさ・強さが変わる案は反映せず、AI がその理由をユーザーに伝えます。 依頼の際に「要件で止めて」「設計で止めて」と指定すると、AI はその段階で停止し、ユーザーは要件定義書や設計書にコメントを付けることができます。 ## 閲覧アプリでの確認と修正の依頼 完成した文章を閲覧アプリで開いて文を選択すると、その文の執筆意図と文機能が右の詳細パネルに表示されます。 違和感を覚えた文にはコメントを残し、「tsuzuri のコメントを読んで直して」と依頼します。 AI はその文を修正し、新しいバージョンに更新します。 新しいバージョンには何を直したかを1行で表すタイトルが付き、文を選択したときのバージョン履歴に表示されます。 修正前の文も記録（「記録の保存先と git」の節）に保存され、アプリはそれと新しい文との差分を表示するため、修正箇所を確認できます。 画面の読み方はアプリを初めて開いたときに表示されるクイックスタートガイドで説明しています。 ## 人や AI が執筆した文章を読む 人やほかの AI が執筆した文章も、「tsuzuri で読んで」と依頼すると、AI が一文ずつ文機能を付与します。 人の文には書き手の執筆意図が無いため、AI は文と前後から推測した執筆意図を付与し、アプリはそれを推測であると明示して表示します。 自分や人が執筆した文章を読ませると、AI はレビューも行って弱い文を指摘するため、そのまま修正も依頼できます。 このとき AI は改善の案を自動では反映せず、ユーザー自身の原稿のようにユーザーが直す前提の文章なら、反映してよいかを確認します。 AI が生成した冗長な公開記事も、サイドバーの重要度の見出しの右でフィルターを選んで「核」（消すと言いたいことが失われる文）を押せば、核の文だけが残るため、本筋を追って読むことができます。 ほかのチャット AI が執筆した文章なら、アプリのライブラリ（文章・テンプレート・校正辞書・プロンプトを切り替えて見る画面。0 キー）で「プロンプト」に切り替え、書いた経緯を書き出させるプロンプトをコピーして、その文章を執筆させた会話に貼り付けて送信してください。 返ってきた答えを文章と一緒に AI コーディングエージェントに渡すと、推測ではなく、執筆した AI 自身の説明から執筆意図を記録します。 ## テンプレートと校正辞書 テンプレートと校正辞書は、ユーザーの決まりと好みを tsuzuri に残しておく場所で、足すほど初回生成の文章がユーザーの好みに近づきます（考え方は「設計の考え方」の「読解の補佐と、好みの言語化」）。
